summary: All three round-1 blocking findings are fixed with red-proven tests, but the fix deletes the LockCliTests class header leaving two lock tests uncollected, and the stale-lock clear carries a verify-then-unlink race its own docstring denies.

findings.summary: The fix deleted the `class LockCliTests(unittest.TestCase):` header, so its two tests silently stopped running (10 test methods defined, 8 collected).
findings.evidence: git diff fb6f95f...HEAD removes the class line; methods sit at module level after the main guard (lines 203-248). test_writers_refuse_under_a_live_foreign_lock is the end-to-end proof of the SEC-3/STD-8 behaviour. ENG-1, ENG-18, ENG-19.
findings.fix: Restore the class header and move the class above the main guard; confirm 10 tests run.

findings.summary: The stale-lock clear compares then unlinks by path as separate steps, so a racer's fresh live lock can be deleted, contradicting the docstring (lines 106-108).
findings.evidence: acquire lines 129-131; needs a stale lock plus two concurrent stealers in a microsecond window; write_state's re-read bounds the damage. ENG-23, ENG-26.
findings.fix: Rename the stale lock to a unique temp name (or compare st_ino/st_dev) before unlinking; correct the docstring.

findings.summary: A `# ponytail:` skill-jargon marker leaked into the shipped acquire comment (all five dist copies).
findings.fix: Rewrite as a plain sentence naming the residual race and the fcntl.flock upgrade; re-render dist.
